roadmap.goal: Story #6084 — remove the 'Fill in past days on over-time charts' switch (OverTimeHistoryFill): the fill always runs and stops being a Preview. Two production moves, each with the test rework DISTILL's Existing-test disposition assigns to it, in the same commit so no commit is red: (1) the fill stops reading the setting — IOverTimeHistoryFillSwitch, OverTimeHistoryFillSwitch and their Program.cs registration are deleted, OverTimeGapReconciler asks the filler whenever days are missing and OverTimeHistoryFiller never drops a waiting pass because of a setting (D5); (2) the setting and #6083's leftovers go — the key moves to OptionalFeatureSeeder.RemoveDeprecatedFeatures and out of GetOptionalFeatures(), the one-time switch-on marker code, SettleTheHistoryFillAfterARestore and its DatabaseManagementService call and AppSettingKeys.HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault are deleted, and AppSettingSeeder gains a key-based obsolete list that removes the 'OptionalFeatures:HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault' row (D2, D3, D4); the E2E suite stops switching the fill in the same commit, because that is the commit that makes the endpoint answer 404. Done when: all sixteen DISTILL cases are un-ignored and green (Story6084HistoryFillAlwaysOnTest 7 methods / 12 cases, Story6084TheFillRunsEverywhereTest 2, AppSettingSeederTests 1, OptionalFeatureSeederTests 1); `grep -rn "Story #6084 — pending DELIVER\|PendingDeliver" Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/API/Integration/BehaviourSettings/Story6084* Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/API/Integration/PercentilesOverTime/Story6084* Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Services/Implementation/Seeding` returns zero matches; no production file names IOverTimeHistoryFillSwitch, OverTimeHistoryFillSwitch, HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault or SettleTheHistoryFillAfterARestore, and OverTimeHistoryFillKey is named in production only by OptionalFeatureKeys.cs and OptionalFeatureSeeder's deprecated-keys list; `dotnet build` has zero warnings; the backend suite is green with `--filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"`, plus the Integration category (live-connector categories still excluded) because Program.cs changes; `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` are green with zero warnings; the touched Playwright specs pass locally. Deliberately NOT steps here — finalize or maintainer gates run or approved on their own: the docs prose (docs/settings/configuration.md section removed, docs/metrics/predictability.md 'Filling in past days' with its three anchors repointed, the docs/releasenotes/releasenotes.md:152 link target repointed, ARCHITECTURE.md lines ~189/~387, the ADR-207 status note); the Lighthouse-Clients copy and its patch release; the release-notes line on ADO #6084; regenerating docs/assets/settings/configuration.png (rm the old PNG first); the full Playwright suite on SQLite and Postgres including DatabaseManagement.spec.ts (DoD 8); Stryker mutation testing on frozen code; ADO state transitions.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply here and its omission is deliberate. This repository is C# + NUnit 4.6 + Moq (backend) and TypeScript + Vitest + RTL / Playwright (frontend, E2E); there is no Hypothesis and no .feature file. DISTILL recorded it (feature-delta.md, DISTILL / Scenario list and the mandate-compliance note under Upstream findings): layer 3+ acceptance, example-only, the one finite axis (how an earlier release left the fill) expressed as an NUnit [TestCase] over an enum. The crafter authors NO new acceptance tests for the story — the sixteen cases were written by DISTILL and sit [Ignore]d. The crafter's RED phase is un-ignoring them and watching them fail exactly as red-classification.md recorded; its GREEN phase is production code. The one test the crafter writes is the move DISTILL's disposition table orders: the controller's generic 'Optional feature {Key} switched from … to …' log assertion leaves Slice09 and lands on the BehaviourSettings harness, switching FeatureOrdering. Every other existing-test edit is a row of that table, executed in the step the table names.

validation.notes: Built from feature-delta.md (DISCUSS Locked Decisions D1-D7, Definition of Done, DISTILL Scenario list, Existing-test disposition, E2E impact, Open-check answers 1-4, Upstream findings 1-5, Pre-requisites) and red-classification.md (16/16 MISSING_FUNCTIONALITY). Checked against the code at HEAD 927ed4e74: (1) the switch is read in exactly two production places — OverTimeGapReconciler's constructor takes IOverTimeHistoryFillSwitch, and OverTimeHistoryFiller.RunOnePassAsync resolves it from the scope (~line 151); the only registration is Program.cs ~line 1412 in RegisterServices. (2) The only other production readers of the fill's key are OptionalFeatureSeeder (GetOptionalFeatures ~86, AddOrUpdateCurrentFeatures ~103/~128, SettleTheHistoryFillAfterARestore ~151-160, RecordThatTheHistoryFillWasSwitchedOn ~168) and OverTimeHistoryFillSwitch.cs itself; AppSettingKeys.HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault is read only by OptionalFeatureSeeder; DatabaseManagementService.MigrateAndSeedDatabase calls SettleTheHistoryFillAfterARestore at ~217. (3) After 01-01, Story6083's suite stays green — it never reads the switch, only the row and the record (DISTILL Pre-requisites). It is deleted in 01-02, which reverses every one of its assertions. (4) DISTILL Pre-requisites: step 02's three decisions must land together — deprecating the row without the key-based removal leaves #2/#3/#4 red on the record; removing the restore hook without deprecating the row leaves #6 red. Hence one step for D2+D3+D4. (5) The Story6084 tests address the setting and the record by literals ('OverTimeHistoryFill', 'OptionalFeatures:HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault'), so deleting AppSettingKeys.HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault breaks none of them. (6) BehaviourSettingsAcceptanceTest has no log capture today; Slice09TheFillShipsOptInSpecifications carries one (CapturedLogMessages via a Serilog sink in ConfigureAdditionalServices), so the moved log assertion brings that capture with it. (7) The E2E callers of switchHistoryFill are optionalFeatures.ts (definition + OVER_TIME_HISTORY_FILL_KEY), PercentilesOverTime/PbcOverTime/PredictabilityOverTime.spec.ts (import + beforeEach/afterEach), and Screenshots.spec.ts (import, ~line 93 in the system-configuration shot, and the testWithDemoHistoryFill fixture ~842-859). user_decisions: D1 — every instance fills, with no way to switch it off, including instances whose System Admin switched it off after the #6083 upgrade. The release notes say the setting is gone and advise a backup before upgrading.

D2 — the row leaves the database in this release: OptionalFeatureKeys.OverTimeHistoryFillKey moves to OptionalFeatureSeeder.RemoveDeprecatedFeatures (as DeltaSyncKey and McpServerKey did) and leaves GetOptionalFeatures(). Seeder data, no EF migration, no CreateMigration run. GET/POST /api/latest/optionalfeatures/OverTimeHistoryFill answer 404 and store nothing. An old replica re-adding the row mid rolling-deploy is an accepted, untested risk.
D3 — #6083's leftovers go entirely: SettleTheHistoryFillAfterARestore and its call in DatabaseManagementService, the marker-writing code, and AppSettingKeys.HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault.

D4 — the marker row is deleted by key: AppSettingSeeder gains a key-based obsolete list holding the literal "OptionalFeatures:HistoryFillSwitchedOnByDefault" (the constant is removed). The existing Id list stays as it is.

D5 — the switch abstraction is deleted, not stubbed: IOverTimeHistoryFillSwitch, OverTimeHistoryFillSwitch and their Program.cs registration go. Bounds, per-visit budget, memo and maintenance gate are unchanged.
D6 — no longer a Preview anywhere; docs headings lose '(Preview)' and old anchors are repointed (finalize).
D7 — docs and release-note copy use the configurable terms (Team, Portfolio, Work Item) and the chart names as they appear.
DISTILL maintainer decision (2026-10-15) — the only visible change is the row disappearing from Settings → System; no UI copy is added or changed, so DELIVER has no UI step to sketch.
out_of_scope: Any change to how the fill works: bounds, the 90-day per-visit budget, the memo, the maintenance gate, the filler's queueing.
Any opt-out by configuration, environment variable or API (D1).
Telling filled days apart from recorded ones, or undoing a fill.
The Preview mechanism itself (IsPreview on other rows, the Settings page's Preview handling).
Any frontend production change; only the two overTimeEmptyState comments change.
The mixed-version rolling-deploy race (Upstream finding 5): accepted risk, not scenario'd.
